SELECT
    rc.loan_id,
    rc.as_of_date
FROM risk_classification rc
JOIN classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
WHERE cg.grade_name_zh = '次级'
ORDER BY rc.loan_id ASC;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.disbursed_amount
FROM
    loan_drawdown ld
WHERE
    ld.status = 'WRITTEN_OFF'

SELECT
    payment_id,
    business_date,
    amount
FROM payment_event
WHERE payment_type = 'CASH_WITHDRAWAL'
  AND amount > 5000000
ORDER BY amount DESC;

SELECT
    pp.party_id,
    pp.annual_income
FROM
    person_profile pp
WHERE
    pp.annual_income > 1000000
ORDER BY
    pp.annual_income DESC;

SELECT
    card_id,
    issued_on,
    expires_on
FROM payment_card
WHERE card_type = 'CREDIT'
ORDER BY issued_on ASC;

SELECT
    op.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    op.operating_status
FROM
    organization_profile op
JOIN
    party p ON op.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN
    organization_unit ou ON p.home_org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
WHERE
    p.party_type = 'CORPORATE'
    AND ou.region_code = (
        SELECT region_code
        FROM organization_unit
        WHERE unit_name = '上海分行'
        LIMIT 1
    )
ORDER BY
    op.party_id ASC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM institution i
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
GROUP BY
    i.institution_id,
    i.institution_name
ORDER BY
    loan_count DESC;

SELECT
    o.org_unit_id,
    o.unit_name,
    COUNT(a.account_id) AS account_count
FROM
    organization_unit o
JOIN
    account a ON o.org_unit_id = a.org_unit_id
GROUP BY
    o.org_unit_id,
    o.unit_name
ORDER BY
    account_count DESC;

SELECT
    t1.sector_name_zh,
    ROUND(SUM(t3.contract_amount), 2) AS contract_amount_sum
FROM
    industry_sector t1
    INNER JOIN organization_profile t2 ON t1.sector_code = t2.industry_code
    INNER JOIN credit_agreement t3 ON t2.party_id = t3.borrower_party_id
GROUP BY
    t1.sector_name_zh
ORDER BY
    contract_amount_sum DESC;

SELECT
    wp.product_name,
    ROUND(SUM(phs.fair_value), 2) AS total_fair_value
FROM wealth_product wp
JOIN product_holding_snapshot phs ON wp.product_id = phs.product_id
WHERE phs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY wp.product_id, wp.product_name
ORDER BY total_fair_value DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name,
    COUNT(pr.relation_id) AS relation_count
FROM party_relation pr
JOIN party p_source ON pr.source_party_id = p_source.party_id
JOIN organization_unit ou ON p_source.home_org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
GROUP BY
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name
ORDER BY
    relation_count DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    cs.net_capital,
    cs.risk_weighted_assets
FROM capital_snapshot cs
JOIN institution i ON cs.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
ORDER BY cs.net_capital DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(SUM(abs(abs(abs_balance.ledger_balance))), 2) AS deposit_balance_sum
FROM account a
JOIN institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN account_balance_snapshot abs_balance ON a.account_id = abs_balance.account_id
WHERE abs_balance.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND a.account_kind = 'SAVINGS'
GROUP BY i.institution_name
ORDER BY deposit_balance_sum DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(AVG(ds.principal_overdue_days), 2) AS avg_principal_overdue_days
FROM delinquency_snapshot ds
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ds.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE ds.principal_overdue_days > 0
GROUP BY i.institution_name
HAVING AVG(ds.principal_overdue_days) > 90
ORDER BY avg_principal_overdue_days DESC;

WITH group_exposure AS (
    SELECT
        eg.exposure_group_id,
        eg.group_name,
        eg.institution_id,
        COALESCE(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 0) AS total_exposure
    FROM exposure_group eg
    JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
    JOIN account_holder ah ON egm.party_id = ah.party_id
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ah.account_id = ld.loan_account_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    WHERE ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name, eg.institution_id
),
group_capital AS (
    SELECT
        institution_id,
        net_capital
    FROM capital_snapshot
    WHERE as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
)
SELECT
    ge.exposure_group_id,
    ge.group_name,
    ROUND(ge.total_exposure, 2) AS exposure_amount,
    ROUND(ge.total_exposure * 1.0 / gc.net_capital, 6) AS exposure_ratio
FROM group_exposure ge
JOIN group_capital gc ON ge.institution_id = gc.institution_id
WHERE gc.net_capital > 0
ORDER BY exposure_ratio DESC;

WITH loan_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        ip.sector_name_zh AS industry_name,
        COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS loan_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN rc.grade_code IN ('SUBSTANDARD', 'DOUBTFUL', 'LOSS') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nonperforming_count
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN organization_profile op ON ca.borrower_party_id = op.party_id
    JOIN industry_sector ip ON op.industry_code = ip.sector_code
    JOIN risk_classification rc ON ld.loan_id = rc.loan_id
    WHERE rc.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    GROUP BY ip.sector_name_zh
    HAVING COUNT(ld.loan_id) >= 20
)
SELECT 
    industry_name,
    loan_count,
    nonperforming_count,
    ROUND(nonperforming_count * 1.0 / loan_count, 6) AS nonperforming_ratio
FROM loan_stats
ORDER BY nonperforming_ratio DESC;

SELECT
    borrower_party_id AS customer_id,
    p.display_name AS customer_name,
    SUM(ca.contract_amount) AS total_contract_amount
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
GROUP BY borrower_party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY total_contract_amount DESC
LIMIT 15;

SELECT
    risk_level,
    COUNT(*) AS product_count,
    ROUND(AVG(management_fee_rate), 2) AS avg_management_fee_rate
FROM wealth_product
GROUP BY risk_level
ORDER BY risk_level ASC;

SELECT
    g.guarantor_party_id AS guarantor_party_id,
    p.display_name AS guarantor_name,
    ROUND(SUM(g.guaranteed_amount), 2) AS total_guaranteed_amount
FROM
    guarantor_commitment g
JOIN
    party p ON g.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE
    g.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY
    g.guarantor_party_id,
    p.display_name
HAVING
    ROUND(SUM(g.guaranteed_amount), 2) > 500000000.00
ORDER BY
    total_guaranteed_amount DESC;

SELECT
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    ROUND(SUM(ca.contract_amount), 2) AS total_contract_amount
FROM party p
JOIN party_relation pr ON p.party_id = pr.source_party_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN relation_type_catalog rtc ON pr.relation_type = rtc.relation_type
WHERE rtc.relation_name_zh != '非关联方'
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING SUM(ca.contract_amount) > 300000000
ORDER BY total_contract_amount DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(d.record_id) AS record_count,
    ROUND(SUM(d.observed_value), 2) AS total_observed_value
FROM data_security_event_v3 d
JOIN institution i ON d.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE d.exception_flag = 1
GROUP BY
    i.institution_id,
    i.institution_name
ORDER BY
    total_observed_value DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(r.record_id) AS overdue_record_count
FROM
    regulatory_submission_event_v3 r
JOIN
    institution i ON r.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE
    r.completion_date IS NULL
    OR r.completion_date > r.deadline_date
GROUP BY
    i.institution_id,
    i.institution_name
HAVING
    COUNT(r.record_id) >= 20
ORDER BY
    overdue_record_count DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(cs.net_capital * 1.0 / cs.risk_weighted_assets, 6) AS capital_adequacy_ratio
FROM institution i
JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON i.institution_id = cs.institution_id
WHERE cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND cs.risk_weighted_assets > 0
ORDER BY capital_adequacy_ratio ASC;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id,
    ds.principal_overdue_days,
    cg.grade_name_zh,
    rc.as_of_date
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN delinquency_snapshot ds
    ON ld.loan_id = ds.loan_id
JOIN risk_classification rc
    ON ld.loan_id = rc.loan_id
JOIN classification_grade cg
    ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
WHERE ds.principal_overdue_days > 90
  AND cg.grade_code IN ('NORMAL', 'SPECIAL_MENTION')
  AND rc.as_of_date = (
      SELECT MAX(rc2.as_of_date)
      FROM risk_classification rc2
      WHERE rc2.loan_id = ld.loan_id
  )
ORDER BY ds.principal_overdue_days DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS insufficient_provision_loan_balance
FROM
    institution i
JOIN
    credit_agreement ca ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
JOIN
    loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN
    loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
JOIN
    provision_snapshot ps ON ld.loan_id = ps.loan_id
WHERE
    lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND ps.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND ps.recognized_amount < ps.required_amount
GROUP BY
    i.institution_name
HAVING
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) > 100000000
ORDER BY
    insufficient_provision_loan_balance DESC;

SELECT
    pi.instruction_id,
    pi.loan_id,
    p.display_name,
    isec.sector_name_zh,
    pi.instruction_amount
FROM payment_instruction pi
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON pi.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN party p ON pi.intended_payee_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
JOIN industry_sector isec ON op.industry_code = isec.sector_code
WHERE isec.risk_category IN ('RESTRICTED', 'EXIT')
  AND pi.status = 'EXECUTED'
ORDER BY pi.instruction_amount DESC;

SELECT
    inst.institution_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ind.risk_category IN ('RESTRICTED', 'EXIT') THEN pi.instruction_amount ELSE 0 END) AS restricted_amount,
    SUM(pi.instruction_amount) AS total_instruction_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ind.risk_category IN ('RESTRICTED', 'EXIT') THEN pi.instruction_amount ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(pi.instruction_amount), 6) AS ratio
FROM payment_instruction pi
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON pi.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution inst ON ca.institution_id = inst.institution_id
LEFT JOIN organization_profile op ON ca.borrower_party_id = op.party_id
LEFT JOIN industry_sector ind ON op.industry_code = ind.sector_code
GROUP BY inst.institution_name
ORDER BY ratio DESC;

SELECT
    wp.product_id,
    wp.product_name,
    ma.asset_id,
    ma.maturity_on,
    wp.actual_termination_on
FROM wealth_product wp
JOIN product_holding_snapshot phs ON wp.product_id = phs.product_id
JOIN managed_asset ma ON phs.asset_id = ma.asset_id
WHERE ma.maturity_on > wp.actual_termination_on
ORDER BY ma.maturity_on DESC;

WITH GuarantorStats AS (
    SELECT 
        gc.guarantor_party_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT gc.commitment_id) AS guarantee_count
    FROM guarantor_commitment gc
    WHERE gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY gc.guarantor_party_id
),
BorrowerStats AS (
    SELECT 
        ca.borrower_party_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ca.agreement_id) AS agreement_count
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    WHERE ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY ca.borrower_party_id
)
SELECT 
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    gs.guarantee_count,
    bs.agreement_count
FROM GuarantorStats gs
INNER JOIN BorrowerStats bs ON gs.guarantor_party_id = bs.borrower_party_id
INNER JOIN party p ON gs.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
ORDER BY gs.guarantee_count DESC;

SELECT
    pe.payment_id,
    pe.business_date,
    ptc.name_zh,
    pe.amount,
    ou.unit_name
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN payment_type_catalog ptc ON pe.payment_type = ptc.payment_type
JOIN organization_unit ou ON pe.origin_org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
WHERE pe.is_cash = 1
  AND pe.amount > 5000000
  AND pe.status = 'SETTLED'
ORDER BY pe.amount DESC;

SELECT
    ca.agreement_id,
    p.display_name,
    op_industry.sector_name_zh AS borrower_industry_name,
    ca_industry.sector_name_zh AS target_industry_name,
    ca.contract_amount
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
LEFT JOIN organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
LEFT JOIN industry_sector op_industry ON op.industry_code = op_industry.sector_code
LEFT JOIN industry_sector ca_industry ON ca.target_industry_code = ca_industry.sector_code
WHERE op.industry_code IS NOT NULL
  AND ca.target_industry_code IS NOT NULL
  AND op.industry_code != ca.target_industry_code
ORDER BY ca.contract_amount DESC;

SELECT
    pe.payment_id,
    pe.business_date,
    pe.amount,
    from_party.party_id AS payer_party_id,
    to_party.party_id AS payee_party_id
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN account from_acct ON pe.from_account_id = from_acct.account_id
JOIN account to_acct ON pe.to_account_id = to_acct.account_id
JOIN account_holder from_holder ON from_acct.account_id = from_holder.account_id
JOIN account_holder to_holder ON to_acct.account_id = to_holder.account_id
JOIN party from_party ON from_holder.party_id = from_party.party_id
JOIN party to_party ON to_holder.party_id = to_party.party_id
JOIN party_relation pr ON (from_party.party_id = pr.source_party_id AND to_party.party_id = pr.target_party_id)
    OR (from_party.party_id = pr.target_party_id AND to_party.party_id = pr.source_party_id)
JOIN relation_type_catalog rtc ON pr.relation_type = rtc.relation_type
WHERE pe.status = 'SETTLED'
  AND rtc.relation_name_zh != '非关联方'
ORDER BY pe.amount DESC

SELECT
    ca.agreement_id,
    p.display_name,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
GROUP BY
    ca.agreement_id,
    p.display_name
HAVING
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) >= 3
ORDER BY
    loan_count DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(pe.payment_id) AS cnt,
    ROUND(SUM(pe.amount), 2) AS total_amount
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN account acc ON pe.from_account_id = acc.account_id
JOIN institution i ON acc.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE pe.is_cash = 1
  AND pe.amount > 5000000
GROUP BY i.institution_name
HAVING cnt >= 50
ORDER BY total_amount DESC;

SELECT
    so.staff_id,
    COUNT(pe.payment_id) AS cnt
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN service_operator so ON pe.operator_id = so.operator_id
JOIN account to_acc ON pe.to_account_id = to_acc.account_id
JOIN account_holder ah ON to_acc.account_id = ah.account_id AND ah.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
JOIN organization_profile op ON ah.party_id = op.party_id
JOIN industry_sector isec ON op.industry_code = isec.sector_code
WHERE isec.risk_category IN ('RESTRICTED', 'EXIT')
GROUP BY so.staff_id
ORDER BY cnt DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT
    t.record_id,
    i.institution_name,
    t.event_date,
    t.deadline_date,
    CAST(julianday('2026-06-30') - julianday(t.deadline_date) AS INTEGER) AS days_diff
FROM customer_due_diligence_event_v3 t
JOIN institution i ON t.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE t.completion_date IS NULL
ORDER BY days_diff DESC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT
    sa.security_id,
    ca.collateral_id,
    ca.status AS collateral_status,
    sa.status AS security_status
FROM
    security_agreement sa
JOIN
    collateral_link cl ON sa.security_id = cl.security_id
JOIN
    collateral_asset ca ON cl.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
WHERE
    ca.status = 'RELEASED'
    AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY
    sa.security_id ASC;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id,
    ca.agreement_id,
    sa.security_id,
    sa.secured_amount
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN secured_obligation so ON ca.agreement_id = so.agreement_id
JOIN security_agreement sa ON so.security_id = sa.security_id
WHERE ld.status = 'WRITTEN_OFF'
  AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY sa.secured_amount DESC;

WITH RankedLoans AS (
    SELECT 
        i.institution_name,
        l.loan_id,
        lbs.principal_balance,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY i.institution_id 
            ORDER BY lbs.principal_balance DESC, l.loan_id ASC
        ) AS balance_rank
    FROM loan_drawdown l
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON l.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON l.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
)
SELECT 
    institution_name,
    loan_id,
    principal_balance,
    balance_rank
FROM RankedLoans
WHERE balance_rank = 1
ORDER BY institution_name ASC;

SELECT
    industry_sector.sector_name_zh,
    loan_drawdown.loan_id,
    loan_balance_snapshot.principal_balance,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY industry_sector.sector_name_zh ORDER BY loan_balance_snapshot.principal_balance DESC) AS rank_in_industry
FROM loan_drawdown
JOIN credit_agreement ON loan_drawdown.agreement_id = credit_agreement.agreement_id
JOIN organization_profile ON credit_agreement.borrower_party_id = organization_profile.party_id
JOIN industry_sector ON organization_profile.industry_code = industry_sector.sector_code
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot ON loan_drawdown.loan_id = loan_balance_snapshot.loan_id
WHERE loan_balance_snapshot.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
ORDER BY industry_sector.sector_name_zh ASC, rank_in_industry ASC
LIMIT 3

WITH daily_txn_count AS (
    SELECT 
        business_date,
        COUNT(*) AS txn_count
    FROM payment_event
    GROUP BY business_date
)
SELECT 
    business_date,
    txn_count,
    txn_count - LAG(txn_count) OVER (ORDER BY business_date) AS count_change
FROM daily_txn_count
ORDER BY business_date ASC;

WITH institution_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        ca.institution_id,
        ROUND(AVG(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS avg_principal_balance
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id
)
SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ld.loan_id,
    lbs.principal_balance,
    ia.avg_principal_balance,
    ROUND(lbs.principal_balance - ia.avg_principal_balance, 2) AS excess_amount
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution_avg ia ON ca.institution_id = ia.institution_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND lbs.principal_balance > ia.avg_principal_balance
ORDER BY excess_amount DESC;

SELECT
    sa.security_id,
    sa.secured_amount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT gc.guarantor_party_id) AS guarantor_count
FROM security_agreement sa
INNER JOIN secured_obligation so ON sa.security_id = so.security_id
INNER JOIN guarantor_commitment gc ON sa.security_id = gc.security_id
LEFT JOIN collateral_link cl ON sa.security_id = cl.security_id
WHERE cl.collateral_id IS NULL
GROUP BY sa.security_id, sa.secured_amount
ORDER BY sa.secured_amount DESC;

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN principal_overdue_days = 0 THEN '未逾期'
        WHEN principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 1 AND 30 THEN '1-30天'
        WHEN principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 31 AND 90 THEN '31-90天'
        WHEN principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 91 AND 180 THEN '91-180天'
        WHEN principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 181 AND 360 THEN '181-360天'
        ELSE '360天以上'
    END AS overdue_interval,
    COUNT(*) AS loan_count
FROM delinquency_snapshot
WHERE as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY
    CASE
        WHEN principal_overdue_days = 0 THEN 0
        WHEN principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 1 AND 30 THEN 1
        WHEN principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 31 AND 90 THEN 2
        WHEN principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 91 AND 180 THEN 3
        WHEN principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 181 AND 360 THEN 4
        ELSE 5
    END
ORDER BY
    CASE
        WHEN principal_overdue_days = 0 THEN 0
        WHEN principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 1 AND 30 THEN 1
        WHEN principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 31 AND 90 THEN 2
        WHEN principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 91 AND 180 THEN 3
        WHEN principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 181 AND 360 THEN 4
        ELSE 5
    END ASC;

SELECT
    collateral_id,
    valued_on,
    COUNT(*) AS record_count
FROM
    collateral_valuation
GROUP BY
    collateral_id,
    valued_on
HAVING
    COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY
    collateral_id ASC;

SELECT
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS loan_count,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS total_principal_balance,
    ROUND(AVG(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS avg_principal_balance
FROM
    party p
JOIN
    credit_agreement ca ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN
    loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN
    loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
WHERE
    p.party_type = 'CORPORATE'
    AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name
ORDER BY
    avg_principal_balance DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT
    ou.unit_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sm.staff_id) AS staff_count,
    COUNT(pe.payment_id) AS transaction_count
FROM organization_unit ou
JOIN staff_member sm ON sm.home_org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
JOIN service_operator so ON so.staff_id = sm.staff_id
JOIN payment_event pe ON pe.operator_id = so.operator_id
WHERE pe.is_cash = 1
GROUP BY ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
    p.customer_segment AS customer_segment,
    COUNT(p.party_id) AS customer_count,
    ROUND(AVG(pp.annual_income), 2) AS avg_annual_income,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN pp.annual_income > 1000000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(p.party_id), 6) AS high_income_ratio
FROM person_profile pp
JOIN party p ON pp.party_id = p.party_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
GROUP BY p.customer_segment
ORDER BY p.customer_segment ASC;

WITH payment_agg AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(acc_from.institution_id, acc_to.institution_id) AS institution_id,
        pe.payment_id,
        pe.amount,
        pe.from_account_id,
        pe.to_account_id
    FROM payment_event pe
    LEFT JOIN account acc_from ON pe.from_account_id = acc_from.account_id
    LEFT JOIN account acc_to ON pe.to_account_id = acc_to.account_id
    WHERE pe.status = 'SETTLED'
),
holder_relations AS (
    SELECT
        pa.institution_id,
        pa.payment_id,
        pa.amount,
        pa.from_account_id,
        pa.to_account_id,
        ph_from.party_id AS from_party_id,
        ph_to.party_id AS to_party_id
    FROM payment_agg pa
    LEFT JOIN account_holder ph_from ON pa.from_account_id = ph_from.account_id AND ph_from.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
    LEFT JOIN account_holder ph_to ON pa.to_account_id = ph_to.account_id AND ph_to.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
    WHERE ph_from.party_id IS NOT NULL
      AND ph_to.party_id IS NOT NULL
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM party_relation pr
          WHERE pr.source_party_id = ph_from.party_id
            AND pr.target_party_id = ph_to.party_id
            AND pr.relation_type != 'NON_RELATED'
      )
),
total_amounts AS (
    SELECT
        institution_id,
        SUM(amount) AS total_amount
    FROM payment_agg
    GROUP BY institution_id
),
related_amounts AS (
    SELECT
        institution_id,
        SUM(amount) AS related_amount
    FROM holder_relations
    GROUP BY institution_id
)
SELECT
    inst.institution_name,
    COALESCE(ra.related_amount, 0.0) AS related_amount,
    ta.total_amount,
    ROUND(COALESCE(ra.related_amount, 0.0) * 1.0 / ta.total_amount, 6) AS ratio
FROM total_amounts ta
JOIN institution inst ON ta.institution_id = inst.institution_id
LEFT JOIN related_amounts ra ON ta.institution_id = ra.institution_id
ORDER BY ratio DESC;

SELECT
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pc.card_id) AS credit_card_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT td.account_id) AS term_deposit_count
FROM party p
INNER JOIN payment_card pc ON p.party_id = pc.holder_party_id
INNER JOIN account acc ON pc.settlement_account_id = acc.account_id
INNER JOIN term_deposit td ON acc.account_id = td.account_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
  AND pc.card_type = 'CREDIT'
GROUP BY
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name
HAVING
    COUNT(DISTINCT pc.card_id) > 0
    AND COUNT(DISTINCT td.account_id) > 0
ORDER BY
    COUNT(DISTINCT td.account_id) DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(AVG(julianday('2026-06-30') - julianday(ld.disbursed_on)), 2) AS avg_loan_age_days
FROM
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN
    institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY
    i.institution_id,
    i.institution_name
ORDER BY
    avg_loan_age_days DESC;

WITH RankedLoans AS (
    SELECT 
        l.loan_id,
        l.principal_balance,
        NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY l.principal_balance DESC) AS quartile_group
    FROM loan_balance_snapshot l
    WHERE l.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
)
SELECT 
    loan_id,
    principal_balance,
    quartile_group
FROM RankedLoans
ORDER BY quartile_group ASC, principal_balance DESC, loan_id ASC
LIMIT 40;

WITH industry_loan_balance AS (
    SELECT 
        ip.industry_code,
        SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS total_balance
    FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN organization_profile ip ON ca.borrower_party_id = ip.party_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
      AND ip.industry_code IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ip.industry_code
),
industry_with_cumulative AS (
    SELECT 
        isc.sector_name_zh AS industry_name,
        ilb.total_balance,
        SUM(ilb.total_balance) OVER (ORDER BY ilb.total_balance DESC) AS cumulative_balance,
        SUM(ilb.total_balance) OVER () AS total_all_balance
    FROM industry_loan_balance ilb
    JOIN industry_sector isc ON ilb.industry_code = isc.sector_code
)
SELECT 
    industry_name,
    ROUND(total_balance, 2) AS total_balance,
    ROUND(cumulative_balance * 1.0 / total_all_balance, 6) AS cumulative_ratio
FROM industry_with_cumulative
WHERE cumulative_balance * 1.0 / total_all_balance <= 0.8
ORDER BY cumulative_ratio ASC;

SELECT
    borrower.party_id AS customer_id,
    borrower.display_name AS customer_name,
    inst.institution_name AS institution_name,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS unsettled_loan_count
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution inst ON ca.institution_id = inst.institution_id
JOIN party borrower ON ca.borrower_party_id = borrower.party_id
WHERE ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY
    borrower.party_id,
    borrower.display_name,
    inst.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(ld.loan_id) >= 2
ORDER BY unsettled_loan_count DESC;

SELECT
    sa.security_id,
    sa.secured_amount,
    ca.collateral_id,
    cv.valuation_amount
FROM security_agreement sa
JOIN secured_obligation so ON sa.security_id = so.security_id
JOIN collateral_link cl ON sa.security_id = cl.security_id
JOIN collateral_asset ca ON cl.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
JOIN collateral_valuation cv ON ca.collateral_id = cv.collateral_id
WHERE cv.valued_on = (
    SELECT MAX(cv2.valued_on)
    FROM collateral_valuation cv2
    WHERE cv2.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
)
AND cv.valuation_amount > 2.0 * sa.secured_amount
ORDER BY (cv.valuation_amount - sa.secured_amount) DESC;

SELECT
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT a.institution_id) AS institution_count
FROM
    party p
JOIN
    account_holder ah ON p.party_id = ah.party_id
JOIN
    account a ON ah.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE
    p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
GROUP BY
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name
HAVING
    COUNT(DISTINCT a.institution_id) > 2
ORDER BY
    institution_count DESC;

SELECT
    from_account_id AS account_id,
    business_date,
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM
    payment_event
WHERE
    from_account_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
    from_account_id,
    business_date
HAVING
    COUNT(*) >= 3
ORDER BY
    transaction_count DESC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS member_count,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS total_principal_balance
FROM institution i
JOIN exposure_group eg ON i.institution_id = eg.institution_id
JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id IN (
    SELECT ca.agreement_id
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    WHERE ca.borrower_party_id = egm.party_id
)
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY i.institution_name
ORDER BY total_principal_balance DESC;

SELECT
    g.guarantor_party_id AS guarantor_party_id,
    p.display_name AS guarantor_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT g.security_id) AS security_contract_count,
    ROUND(SUM(g.guaranteed_amount), 2) AS total_guaranteed_amount
FROM guarantor_commitment g
JOIN party p ON g.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE g.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY g.guarantor_party_id, p.display_name
HAVING total_guaranteed_amount > 300000000
ORDER BY total_guaranteed_amount DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE ld.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT'
  AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY
    i.institution_name
ORDER BY
    loan_count DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(ls.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM loan_balance_snapshot ls
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ls.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE ls.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND ls.overdue_since IS NOT NULL
  AND (julianday('2026-06-30') - julianday(ls.overdue_since)) >= 90
GROUP BY i.institution_name
ORDER BY loan_count DESC;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id,
    borrower.display_name AS borrower_name,
    pi.instruction_amount,
    payee.display_name AS payee_name
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN party borrower ON ca.borrower_party_id = borrower.party_id
JOIN payment_instruction pi ON ld.loan_id = pi.loan_id
JOIN party payee ON pi.intended_payee_party_id = payee.party_id
WHERE
    pi.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT'
    AND pi.intended_payee_party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
ORDER BY
    pi.instruction_amount DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT
    t1.agreement_id,
    t2.display_name,
    t1.contract_amount
FROM credit_agreement AS t1
JOIN party AS t2
    ON t1.borrower_party_id = t2.party_id
WHERE t2.status = 'FROZEN'
  AND t1.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY t1.contract_amount DESC

SELECT
    ld.loan_id,
    lpc.product_name_zh,
    isec.sector_name_zh,
    ld.disbursed_amount
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN loan_product_catalog lpc ON ld.drawdown_type = lpc.product_code
JOIN industry_sector isec ON ca.target_industry_code = isec.sector_code
WHERE
    lpc.product_family = 'WORKING_CAPITAL'
    AND isec.risk_category = 'EXIT'
    AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY ld.disbursed_amount DESC
LIMIT 200;

WITH institution_avg AS (
    SELECT
        ca.institution_id,
        ROUND(AVG(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS avg_balance
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id
)
SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    ld.loan_id,
    lbs.principal_balance,
    ia.avg_balance,
    ROUND(lbs.principal_balance - ia.avg_balance, 2) AS excess_amount
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution_avg ia ON ca.institution_id = ia.institution_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND lbs.principal_balance > 2.0 * ia.avg_balance
ORDER BY excess_amount DESC;

WITH institution_total AS (
    SELECT 
        ca.institution_id,
        SUM(ca.contract_amount) AS total_amount
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id
),
non_related_amount AS (
    SELECT 
        ca.institution_id,
        SUM(ca.contract_amount) AS non_related_amount
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    WHERE ca.borrower_party_id NOT IN (
        SELECT pr.target_party_id
        FROM party_relation pr
        WHERE pr.relation_type != 'NON_RELATED'
    )
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id
)
SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COALESCE(nra.non_related_amount, 0) AS non_related_amount,
    it.total_amount,
    ROUND(COALESCE(nra.non_related_amount, 0) * 1.0 / it.total_amount, 6) AS ratio
FROM institution_total it
JOIN institution i ON it.institution_id = i.institution_id
LEFT JOIN non_related_amount nra ON it.institution_id = nra.institution_id
ORDER BY ratio DESC;

WITH borrower_loan_balance AS (
    SELECT 
        ca.institution_id,
        ca.borrower_party_id,
        SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS total_loan_balance
    FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
      AND ca.borrower_party_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id, ca.borrower_party_id
),
institution_capital AS (
    SELECT 
        cs.institution_id,
        cs.net_capital
    FROM capital_snapshot cs
    WHERE cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
      AND cs.currency_code = 'CNY'
),
concentration_calc AS (
    SELECT 
        inst.institution_name,
        p.display_name AS customer_name,
        blb.total_loan_balance,
        ic.net_capital,
        ROUND(blb.total_loan_balance * 1.0 / ic.net_capital, 6) AS concentration_ratio
    FROM borrower_loan_balance blb
    JOIN institution_capital ic ON blb.institution_id = ic.institution_id
    JOIN institution inst ON blb.institution_id = inst.institution_id
    JOIN party p ON blb.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
    WHERE ic.net_capital > 0
)
SELECT 
    institution_name,
    customer_name,
    total_loan_balance,
    net_capital,
    concentration_ratio
FROM concentration_calc
WHERE concentration_ratio > 0.10
ORDER BY concentration_ratio DESC
LIMIT 200;

WITH industry_avg_rate AS (
    SELECT 
        target_industry_code,
        ROUND(AVG(annual_interest_rate), 4) as avg_rate
    FROM credit_agreement
    WHERE annual_interest_rate IS NOT NULL
      AND target_industry_code IS NOT NULL
      AND status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY target_industry_code
)
SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id,
    p.display_name,
    ca.annual_interest_rate,
    ia.avg_rate,
    ROUND((ca.annual_interest_rate - ia.avg_rate) * 100.0 / ia.avg_rate, 2) as spread_pct
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN industry_avg_rate ia ON ca.target_industry_code = ia.target_industry_code
JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE ca.annual_interest_rate IS NOT NULL
  AND ia.avg_rate > 0
  AND (ca.annual_interest_rate - ia.avg_rate) * 100.0 / ia.avg_rate > 10
ORDER BY spread_pct DESC, ca.agreement_id ASC;

WITH loan_balance AS (
    SELECT 
        ld.agreement_id,
        SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS total_principal_balance
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    GROUP BY ld.agreement_id
),
institution_capital AS (
    SELECT 
        cs.institution_id,
        MAX(cs.net_capital) AS net_capital
    FROM capital_snapshot cs
    WHERE cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    GROUP BY cs.institution_id
),
borrower_exposure AS (
    SELECT 
        ca.institution_id,
        ca.borrower_party_id,
        SUM(lb.total_principal_balance) AS total_exposure
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    JOIN loan_balance lb ON ca.agreement_id = lb.agreement_id
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id, ca.borrower_party_id
),
threshold_check AS (
    SELECT 
        be.institution_id,
        be.borrower_party_id,
        be.total_exposure,
        ic.net_capital,
        CASE 
            WHEN ic.net_capital > 0 AND be.total_exposure * 1.0 / ic.net_capital > 0.1 THEN 1 
            ELSE 0 
        END AS is_exceeding
    FROM borrower_exposure be
    JOIN institution_capital ic ON be.institution_id = ic.institution_id
)
SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    SUM(tc.is_exceeding) AS exceeding_customer_count
FROM threshold_check tc
JOIN institution i ON tc.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING SUM(tc.is_exceeding) > 0
ORDER BY exceeding_customer_count DESC;

WITH group_exposure AS (
    SELECT 
        eg.exposure_group_id,
        eg.group_name,
        eg.institution_id,
        SUM(lds.principal_balance) AS total_exposure
    FROM exposure_group eg
    JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = egm.party_id AND ca.institution_id = eg.institution_id
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lds ON ld.loan_id = lds.loan_id
    WHERE lds.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    GROUP BY eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name, eg.institution_id
),
group_capital AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id,
        net_capital
    FROM capital_snapshot
    WHERE as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
),
group_concentration AS (
    SELECT 
        ge.exposure_group_id,
        ge.group_name,
        ge.total_exposure,
        gc.net_capital,
        ROUND(ge.total_exposure * 1.0 / gc.net_capital, 6) AS concentration_ratio
    FROM group_exposure ge
    JOIN group_capital gc ON ge.institution_id = gc.institution_id
    WHERE gc.net_capital > 0
)
SELECT 
    exposure_group_id,
    group_name,
    ROUND(total_exposure, 2) AS total_exposure,
    ROUND(net_capital, 2) AS net_capital,
    concentration_ratio
FROM group_concentration
WHERE concentration_ratio > 0.1
ORDER BY concentration_ratio DESC;

SELECT
    ca.agreement_id,
    ca.maturity_on,
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.status,
    ca.contract_amount
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
WHERE ca.status = 'MATURED'
  AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.loan_account_id,
    ld.disbursed_on,
    pe.payment_id,
    pe.business_date,
    pe.amount,
    CAST(julianday(pe.business_date) - julianday(ld.disbursed_on) AS INTEGER) AS interval_days
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN payment_event pe
    ON pe.from_account_id = ld.loan_account_id
    AND pe.business_date > ld.disbursed_on
    AND pe.business_date <= date(ld.disbursed_on, '+7 days')
    AND pe.status = 'SETTLED'
ORDER BY
    interval_days ASC,
    pe.amount DESC,
    ld.loan_id ASC;

WITH loan_balance AS (
    SELECT
        ld.agreement_id,
        ca.institution_id,
        ca.borrower_party_id,
        SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS total_principal_balance
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    GROUP BY ld.agreement_id, ca.institution_id, ca.borrower_party_id
),
client_loan_balance AS (
    SELECT
        institution_id,
        borrower_party_id,
        SUM(total_principal_balance) AS total_client_principal_balance
    FROM loan_balance
    GROUP BY institution_id, borrower_party_id
),
institution_capital AS (
    SELECT
        institution_id,
        net_capital
    FROM capital_snapshot
    WHERE as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
),
client_ratio AS (
    SELECT
        clb.institution_id,
        clb.borrower_party_id,
        clb.total_client_principal_balance,
        ic.net_capital,
        ROUND(clb.total_client_principal_balance * 1.0 / ic.net_capital, 6) AS ratio
    FROM client_loan_balance clb
    JOIN institution_capital ic ON clb.institution_id = ic.institution_id
    WHERE ic.net_capital > 0
),
ranked_clients AS (
    SELECT
        cr.institution_id,
        cr.borrower_party_id,
        cr.ratio,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cr.institution_id ORDER BY cr.ratio DESC) AS rn
    FROM client_ratio cr
)
SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    p.display_name AS customer_name,
    rc.ratio
FROM ranked_clients rc
JOIN institution i ON rc.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN party p ON rc.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE rc.rn = 1
ORDER BY i.institution_name ASC;

WITH RankedLoans AS (
    SELECT 
        l.loan_id,
        lbs.principal_balance,
        NTILE(4) OVER (PARTITION BY l.agreement_id ORDER BY lbs.principal_balance DESC) AS rank_quartile
    FROM loan_drawdown l
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON l.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
)
SELECT 
    loan_id,
    principal_balance,
    rank_quartile
FROM RankedLoans
ORDER BY rank_quartile ASC, principal_balance DESC
LIMIT 300;

WITH loan_balance_latest AS (
    SELECT 
        lds.loan_id,
        lds.principal_balance,
        lds.as_of_date
    FROM loan_balance_snapshot lds
    WHERE lds.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND lds.principal_balance > 0
),
institution_loan_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        ca.institution_id,
        SUM(lbl.principal_balance) AS total_institution_principal
    FROM loan_balance_latest lbl
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON lbl.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id
),
ranked_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        lbl.loan_id,
        inst.institution_name,
        lbl.principal_balance,
        ROUND(lbl.principal_balance * 100.0 / ilt.total_institution_principal, 2) AS ratio_percent,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY inst.institution_id 
            ORDER BY lbl.principal_balance * 100.0 / ilt.total_institution_principal DESC, lbl.loan_id ASC
        ) AS rn
    FROM loan_balance_latest lbl
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON lbl.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN institution inst ON ca.institution_id = inst.institution_id
    JOIN institution_loan_totals ilt ON ca.institution_id = ilt.institution_id
)
SELECT 
    loan_id,
    institution_name,
    principal_balance,
    ratio_percent
FROM ranked_loans
WHERE rn <= 300
ORDER BY institution_name ASC, ratio_percent DESC, loan_id ASC;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id,
    ROUND(ld.disbursed_amount, 2) AS disbursed_amount,
    ld.status,
    ROUND(lbs.overdue_principal, 2) AS overdue_principal,
    rs.overdue_count
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
JOIN (
    SELECT
        loan_id,
        COUNT(*) AS overdue_count
    FROM repayment_schedule
    WHERE status = 'OVERDUE'
    GROUP BY loan_id
) rs ON ld.loan_id = rs.loan_id
WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND rs.overdue_count >= 2
ORDER BY rs.overdue_count DESC, lbs.overdue_principal DESC, ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT
    loan_account_id,
    disbursed_on,
    COUNT(loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM loan_drawdown
WHERE loan_account_id IS NOT NULL
  AND disbursed_on IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
    loan_account_id,
    disbursed_on
HAVING
    COUNT(loan_id) >= 2
ORDER BY
    loan_count DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT
    t1.party_id
FROM (
    SELECT
        ah.party_id
    FROM account_holder ah
    JOIN account a ON ah.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN term_deposit td ON a.account_id = td.account_id
    WHERE ah.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
    GROUP BY ah.party_id
) t1
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT
        ca.borrower_party_id
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    GROUP BY ca.borrower_party_id
) t2
ON t1.party_id = t2.borrower_party_id
ORDER BY t1.party_id ASC;

SELECT
    sm.person_party_id
FROM
    staff_member sm
WHERE
    sm.employment_status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND sm.person_party_id NOT IN (
        SELECT
            ah.party_id
        FROM
            account_holder ah
    )
ORDER BY
    sm.person_party_id ASC;

SELECT
    a.account_id
FROM
    account a
WHERE
    a.account_kind = 'SAVINGS'
    AND a.account_id NOT IN (
        SELECT
            pe.from_account_id
        FROM
            payment_event pe
        WHERE
            pe.is_cash = 1
            AND pe.payment_type = 'CASH_WITHDRAWAL'
    )
ORDER BY
    a.account_id ASC
LIMIT 300;

SELECT
    t1.security_id,
    t1.guaranteed_amount
FROM guarantor_commitment AS t1
WHERE t1.status = 'EXPIRED'
ORDER BY t1.guaranteed_amount DESC;

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN remaining_days < 0 THEN '已到期'
        WHEN remaining_days <= 90 THEN '临期'
        ELSE '常态'
    END AS 档位,
    COUNT(*) AS 笔数
FROM (
    SELECT
        loan_id,
        CASE
            WHEN current_maturity_on < '2026-06-30' THEN julianday('2026-06-30') - julianday(current_maturity_on)
            ELSE julianday(current_maturity_on) - julianday('2026-06-30')
        END AS remaining_days
    FROM loan_drawdown
)
GROUP BY 档位
ORDER BY
    CASE 档位
        WHEN '常态' THEN 1
        WHEN '临期' THEN 2
        WHEN '已到期' THEN 3
    END;

SELECT
    cl.collateral_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cl.security_id) AS link_count
FROM
    collateral_link cl
JOIN
    security_agreement sa ON cl.security_id = sa.security_id
WHERE
    cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY
    cl.collateral_id
HAVING
    COUNT(DISTINCT cl.security_id) > 1
ORDER BY
    link_count DESC;

SELECT
    ca.collateral_type AS 押品种类,
    ROUND(AVG(cv.valuation_amount), 2) AS 平均评估价值,
    COUNT(cv.valuation_id) AS 评估笔数
FROM collateral_valuation cv
JOIN collateral_asset ca ON cv.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
WHERE cv.valuation_type = 'INTERNAL'
GROUP BY ca.collateral_type
ORDER BY 平均评估价值 DESC;

WITH AccountLoanStats AS (
    SELECT 
        ld.repayment_account_id AS repayment_account_id,
        ld.loan_id,
        ld.disbursed_on,
        ld.disbursed_amount,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY ld.repayment_account_id) AS loan_count
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    WHERE ld.repayment_account_id IS NOT NULL
),
RankedLoans AS (
    SELECT 
        repayment_account_id,
        loan_id,
        disbursed_on,
        disbursed_amount,
        loan_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY repayment_account_id ORDER BY disbursed_on ASC) AS rn
    FROM AccountLoanStats
    WHERE loan_count >= 3
)
SELECT 
    repayment_account_id,
    loan_id,
    disbursed_on,
    disbursed_amount,
    loan_count
FROM RankedLoans
WHERE rn <= 2
ORDER BY repayment_account_id ASC, disbursed_on ASC;

SELECT
    ca.agreement_id,
    ca.contract_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(ld.disbursed_amount), 2) AS total_disbursed_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) - ca.contract_amount, 2) AS excess_amount,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
GROUP BY ca.agreement_id, ca.contract_amount
HAVING SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) > ca.contract_amount
ORDER BY ca.agreement_id ASC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(a.account_id) AS account_count,
    ROUND(SUM(ABS(a_bs.ledger_balance - a_bs.available_balance)), 2) AS total_difference
FROM account a
JOIN account_balance_snapshot a_bs
    ON a.account_id = a_bs.account_id
JOIN institution i
    ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE a_bs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND a_bs.ledger_balance > a_bs.available_balance
  AND (a_bs.ledger_balance - a_bs.available_balance) > 5000000
GROUP BY
    i.institution_name
ORDER BY
    total_difference DESC;

SELECT
    t.account_id,
    t.opening_principal,
    t.maturity_on,
    t.annual_interest_rate
FROM term_deposit t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE t.maturity_on < '2026-06-30'
  AND a.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY t.maturity_on ASC;

SELECT
    card_id,
    card_type,
    issued_on
FROM
    payment_card
WHERE
    issued_on <= '2025-01-31'
    AND status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND card_type = 'DEBIT'
ORDER BY
    issued_on ASC,
    card_id ASC;

WITH payment_mode_stats AS (
    SELECT
        ca.institution_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ld.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT' THEN ld.disbursed_amount ELSE 0 END) AS entrusted_amount,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ld.payment_mode = 'SELF_PAYMENT' THEN ld.disbursed_amount ELSE 0 END) AS self_payment_amount,
        SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) AS total_amount
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    WHERE ld.payment_mode IN ('ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT', 'SELF_PAYMENT')
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id
)
SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(pms.entrusted_amount, 2) AS entrusted_amount,
    ROUND(pms.self_payment_amount, 2) AS self_payment_amount,
    ROUND(pms.entrusted_amount * 1.0 / pms.total_amount, 6) AS entrusted_ratio
FROM payment_mode_stats pms
JOIN institution i ON pms.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE pms.total_amount > 0
  AND (pms.entrusted_amount * 1.0 / pms.total_amount) < 0.52
ORDER BY entrusted_ratio ASC, i.institution_name ASC;

WITH contract_totals AS (
    SELECT
        agreement_id,
        SUM(disbursed_amount) AS total_disbursed
    FROM loan_drawdown
    GROUP BY agreement_id
)
SELECT
    ld.agreement_id AS 授信合同编号,
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    ld.disbursed_amount AS 单笔放款金额,
    ct.total_disbursed AS 合同内累计放款金额,
    ROUND(ld.disbursed_amount * 1.0 / ct.total_disbursed * 100, 2) AS 单笔占比
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN contract_totals ct ON ld.agreement_id = ct.agreement_id
WHERE ld.disbursed_amount * 1.0 / ct.total_disbursed > 0.9
ORDER BY ld.agreement_id ASC;

SELECT
    inst.institution_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN wp.status = 'ON_SALE' THEN wp.planned_raise_amount ELSE 0 END) AS planned_raise_amount,
    SUM(wp.actual_raise_amount) AS actual_raise_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(wp.actual_raise_amount) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN wp.status = 'ON_SALE' THEN wp.planned_raise_amount ELSE 0 END), 6) AS completion_rate
FROM wealth_product wp
JOIN institution inst ON wp.issuer_institution_id = inst.institution_id
GROUP BY inst.institution_name
HAVING completion_rate > 1.2
ORDER BY completion_rate DESC;

WITH borrower_loan_stats AS (
    SELECT
        ca.borrower_party_id,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN rs.status = 'OVERDUE' THEN 1 END) AS overdue_count,
        COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS total_count
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    LEFT JOIN repayment_schedule rs ON ld.loan_id = rs.loan_id
    WHERE ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY ca.borrower_party_id
    HAVING overdue_count > 0 AND total_count > overdue_count
)
SELECT
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    bls.overdue_count,
    bls.total_count
FROM borrower_loan_stats bls
JOIN party p ON bls.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
ORDER BY bls.overdue_count DESC, p.party_id ASC;

SELECT
    pi.instruction_id,
    pi.loan_id,
    borrower.display_name AS borrower_name,
    payee.display_name AS payee_name,
    pi.instruction_amount
FROM payment_instruction pi
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON pi.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN party borrower ON ca.borrower_party_id = borrower.party_id
LEFT JOIN party payee ON pi.intended_payee_party_id = payee.party_id
WHERE pi.status = 'EXECUTED'
  AND pi.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT'
  AND ca.borrower_party_id != pi.intended_payee_party_id
ORDER BY pi.instruction_amount DESC, pi.instruction_id ASC;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.disbursed_on,
    ca.agreement_id,
    ca.signed_on,
    ld.disbursed_amount
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
WHERE ld.disbursed_on < ca.signed_on
ORDER BY ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT
    t.loan_id,
    t.uncleared_installment_count,
    ROUND(t.total_principal_due, 2) AS total_principal_due
FROM (
    SELECT
        rs.loan_id,
        COUNT(rs.installment_id) AS uncleared_installment_count,
        SUM(rs.principal_due) AS total_principal_due
    FROM repayment_schedule rs
    GROUP BY rs.loan_id
    HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN rs.status = 'PAID' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0
) t
ORDER BY t.total_principal_due DESC, t.loan_id ASC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT
    t1.loan_id,
    ROUND(t1.principal_balance, 2) AS principal_balance,
    ROUND(t1.overdue_principal, 2) AS overdue_principal
FROM loan_drawdown t0
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot t1
    ON t0.loan_id = t1.loan_id
WHERE t0.status = 'WRITTEN_OFF'
  AND t1.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND t1.principal_balance > 10000000
ORDER BY t1.principal_balance DESC, t0.loan_id ASC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.disbursed_on,
    ld.disbursement_account_id,
    a.opened_on
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN account a ON ld.disbursement_account_id = a.account_id
WHERE ld.disbursed_on < a.opened_on
ORDER BY ld.disbursed_on ASC, ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.disbursement_account_id,
    a.account_kind,
    ld.disbursed_amount
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN account a ON ld.disbursement_account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.account_kind = 'SAVINGS'
ORDER BY ld.disbursed_amount DESC, ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT
    t1.agreement_id,
    t1.security_type,
    t1.contract_amount,
    t2.display_name
FROM credit_agreement t1
JOIN party t2
    ON t1.borrower_party_id = t2.party_id
WHERE t1.security_type = 'CREDIT'
  AND t1.contract_amount > 8000000
ORDER BY t1.contract_amount DESC, t1.agreement_id ASC

WITH institution_product_avg_rate AS (
    SELECT 
        ca.institution_id,
        ca.product_family,
        ROUND(AVG(ca.annual_interest_rate), 4) AS avg_rate
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    WHERE ca.annual_interest_rate IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id, ca.product_family
),
related_borrowers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        pr.target_party_id AS borrower_id
    FROM party_relation pr
    JOIN relation_type_catalog rtc ON pr.relation_type = rtc.relation_type
    WHERE rtc.relation_name_zh != '非关联方'
),
borrower_info AS (
    SELECT 
        p.party_id,
        p.display_name
    FROM party p
    WHERE p.party_id IN (SELECT borrower_id FROM related_borrowers)
)
SELECT 
    bi.display_name AS borrower_name,
    bi.party_id AS borrower_id,
    ca.annual_interest_rate AS contract_rate,
    ipar.avg_rate AS avg_product_rate,
    ROUND(ca.annual_interest_rate - ipar.avg_rate, 4) AS rate_spread
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN institution_product_avg_rate ipar 
    ON ca.institution_id = ipar.institution_id 
    AND ca.product_family = ipar.product_family
JOIN borrower_info bi 
    ON ca.borrower_party_id = bi.party_id
WHERE ca.annual_interest_rate < ipar.avg_rate
ORDER BY rate_spread DESC;

SELECT
    pr.source_party_id,
    pr.target_party_id,
    rtc.relation_name_zh
FROM
    party_relation pr
JOIN
    relation_type_catalog rtc ON pr.relation_type = rtc.relation_type
WHERE
    rtc.relation_name_zh != '非关联方'
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM loan_drawdown ld1
        WHERE ld1.agreement_id IN (
            SELECT ca.agreement_id
            FROM credit_agreement ca
            WHERE ca.borrower_party_id = pr.source_party_id
        )
    )
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM loan_drawdown ld2
        WHERE ld2.agreement_id IN (
            SELECT ca.agreement_id
            FROM credit_agreement ca
            WHERE ca.borrower_party_id = pr.target_party_id
        )
    )
ORDER BY
    rtc.relation_name_zh,
    pr.relation_id;

WITH group_loan_balance AS (
    SELECT 
        eg.exposure_group_id,
        eg.group_name,
        COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS member_count,
        SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS total_loan_balance
    FROM exposure_group eg
    JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON eg.institution_id = ca.institution_id 
        AND ca.borrower_party_id = egm.party_id
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id 
        AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    WHERE ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name
    HAVING member_count >= 2
),
group_capital AS (
    SELECT 
        eg.institution_id,
        cs.net_capital
    FROM exposure_group eg
    JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON eg.institution_id = cs.institution_id 
        AND cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
),
combined AS (
    SELECT 
        glb.group_name,
        glb.member_count,
        glb.total_loan_balance,
        gc.net_capital,
        ROUND(glb.total_loan_balance * 1.0 / gc.net_capital, 6) AS ratio
    FROM group_loan_balance glb
    JOIN group_capital gc ON glb.exposure_group_id = (
        SELECT exposure_group_id FROM exposure_group WHERE institution_id = gc.institution_id LIMIT 1
    )
)
SELECT 
    group_name,
    member_count,
    ROUND(total_loan_balance, 2) AS total_loan_balance,
    ROUND(net_capital, 2) AS net_capital,
    ratio
FROM combined
WHERE ratio > 0.1
ORDER BY ratio DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT
    payer.display_name AS payer_name,
    payee.display_name AS payee_name,
    COUNT(pe.payment_id) AS transaction_count,
    ROUND(SUM(pe.amount), 2) AS total_amount
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN account acc_from ON pe.from_account_id = acc_from.account_id
JOIN account acc_to ON pe.to_account_id = acc_to.account_id
JOIN account_holder ah_from ON acc_from.account_id = ah_from.account_id
JOIN account_holder ah_to ON acc_to.account_id = ah_to.account_id
JOIN party payer ON ah_from.party_id = payer.party_id
JOIN party payee ON ah_to.party_id = payee.party_id
JOIN party_relation pr ON (pr.source_party_id = ah_from.party_id AND pr.target_party_id = ah_to.party_id)
    OR (pr.source_party_id = ah_to.party_id AND pr.target_party_id = ah_from.party_id)
WHERE
    pr.relation_type != 'NON_RELATED'
    AND pe.status = 'SETTLED'
GROUP BY
    payer.display_name,
    payee.display_name
ORDER BY
    total_amount DESC;

SELECT
    wp.product_id,
    wp.product_name,
    ma.asset_name
FROM wealth_product wp
JOIN product_holding_snapshot phs ON wp.product_id = phs.product_id
JOIN managed_asset ma ON phs.asset_id = ma.asset_id
WHERE wp.status = 'ON_SALE'
  AND wp.risk_level = 'R5'
  AND phs.lookthrough_depth > 1
ORDER BY wp.product_id ASC;

SELECT
    t1.product_id,
    COUNT(t1.asset_id) AS asset_count
FROM product_holding_snapshot t1
WHERE t1.lookthrough_depth > 1
GROUP BY t1.product_id
ORDER BY asset_count DESC
LIMIT 20

SELECT
    lds.loan_id,
    lds.principal_balance,
    MAX(ds.principal_overdue_days) AS max_overdue_days
FROM loan_balance_snapshot lds
JOIN delinquency_snapshot ds ON lds.loan_id = ds.loan_id
WHERE lds.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND ds.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND lds.principal_balance > 90000000
  AND lds.overdue_principal > 0
GROUP BY lds.loan_id, lds.principal_balance
HAVING MAX(ds.principal_overdue_days) >= 200
ORDER BY max_overdue_days DESC, lds.loan_id ASC;

SELECT
    eg.exposure_group_id,
    eg.group_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca.institution_id) AS institution_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS member_count
FROM exposure_group eg
JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON egm.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
WHERE ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ca.institution_id) >= 2
ORDER BY institution_count DESC;

SELECT
    eg.exposure_group_id AS exposure_group_id,
    eg.group_name AS group_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT m.party_id) AS overdue_member_count,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.overdue_principal), 2) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM exposure_group_member m
JOIN exposure_group eg ON m.exposure_group_id = eg.exposure_group_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id IN (
    SELECT ca.agreement_id
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    WHERE ca.borrower_party_id = m.party_id
)
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND lbs.overdue_principal > 0
GROUP BY
    eg.exposure_group_id,
    eg.group_name
ORDER BY
    total_overdue_principal DESC;

WITH borrower_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        ca.borrower_party_id,
        SUM(ca.contract_amount) AS total_loan_amount
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    WHERE ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY ca.borrower_party_id
),
guarantor_guarantees AS (
    SELECT 
        gc.guarantor_party_id,
        SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) AS total_guarantee_amount
    FROM guarantor_commitment gc
    WHERE gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY gc.guarantor_party_id
)
SELECT 
    p.display_name AS 企业名称,
    p.party_id AS 客户编号,
    gg.total_guarantee_amount AS 对外担保合计,
    bl.total_loan_amount AS 自身借款合计,
    ROUND(gg.total_guarantee_amount - bl.total_loan_amount, 2) AS 担保负债差额
FROM party p
INNER JOIN borrower_loans bl ON p.party_id = bl.borrower_party_id
INNER JOIN guarantor_guarantees gg ON p.party_id = gg.guarantor_party_id
WHERE gg.total_guarantee_amount > bl.total_loan_amount
ORDER BY 担保负债差额 DESC;

SELECT
    p.display_name AS employee_name,
    sm.staff_id AS staff_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca.agreement_id) AS agreement_count
FROM staff_member sm
JOIN party p ON sm.person_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON sm.person_party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
WHERE sm.employment_status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY p.display_name, sm.staff_id
ORDER BY agreement_count DESC;

SELECT
    p.display_name,
    p.party_id,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS principal_balance_sum,
    pp.annual_income,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income, 2) AS balance_to_income_ratio
FROM
    party p
JOIN
    organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
JOIN
    person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
JOIN
    account_holder ah ON p.party_id = ah.party_id
JOIN
    account a ON ah.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN
    loan_drawdown ld ON a.account_id = ld.loan_account_id
JOIN
    loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
WHERE
    p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
    AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND pp.annual_income > 0
GROUP BY
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    pp.annual_income
HAVING
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income, 2) > 2
ORDER BY
    balance_to_income_ratio DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT
    p.display_name AS employee_name,
    so.operator_id,
    so.authority_level,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca.agreement_id) AS self_loan_agreement_count
FROM
    staff_member sm
JOIN
    party p ON sm.person_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN
    service_operator so ON sm.staff_id = so.staff_id
JOIN
    credit_agreement ca ON sm.person_party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
WHERE
    so.operator_kind = 'CREDIT_CLERK'
    AND ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY
    p.display_name,
    so.operator_id,
    so.authority_level
ORDER BY
    self_loan_agreement_count DESC;

SELECT
    p.display_name AS employee_name,
    ld.loan_id AS loan_id,
    ld.disbursed_amount AS disbursed_amount,
    ld.disbursed_on AS disbursed_on
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN account acc ON ld.disbursement_account_id = acc.account_id
JOIN account_holder ah ON acc.account_id = ah.account_id
JOIN party p ON ah.party_id = p.party_id
WHERE ah.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
  AND p.party_type = 'STAFF'
ORDER BY ld.disbursed_amount DESC;

WITH borrower_loan_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        ca.borrower_party_id,
        SUM(rs.principal_due + rs.interest_due) AS total_repayment_due
    FROM repayment_schedule rs
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON rs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    WHERE ca.borrower_party_id IN (
        SELECT party_id FROM party WHERE party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
    )
    GROUP BY ca.borrower_party_id
),
borrower_info AS (
    SELECT 
        p.party_id,
        p.display_name,
        pp.annual_income
    FROM party p
    LEFT JOIN person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
    WHERE p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
)
SELECT 
    bi.display_name,
    bi.party_id,
    bi.annual_income,
    ROUND(blt.total_repayment_due, 2) AS total_repayment_due,
    ROUND(CASE 
        WHEN bi.annual_income IS NULL OR bi.annual_income = 0 THEN NULL 
        ELSE blt.total_repayment_due * 1.0 / bi.annual_income 
    END, 2) AS repayment_to_income_ratio
FROM borrower_info bi
JOIN borrower_loan_totals blt ON bi.party_id = blt.borrower_party_id
ORDER BY repayment_to_income_ratio DESC, bi.party_id ASC
LIMIT 50;

SELECT
    lpc.product_family AS product_category_name,
    COUNT(rs.installment_id) AS overdue_installment_count,
    ROUND(SUM(rs.principal_due), 2) AS overdue_principal_sum
FROM repayment_schedule rs
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON rs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN loan_product_catalog lpc ON ld.drawdown_type = lpc.product_code
WHERE rs.status = 'OVERDUE'
GROUP BY lpc.product_family
ORDER BY overdue_principal_sum DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN td.maturity_on < '2026-06-30' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS expired_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN td.maturity_on >= '2026-06-30' AND td.maturity_on <= DATE('2026-06-30', '+90 days') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS within_90_days_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN td.maturity_on > DATE('2026-06-30', '+90 days') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS beyond_90_days_count
FROM account a
JOIN institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN term_deposit td ON a.account_id = td.account_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING expired_count >= 20
ORDER BY expired_count DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS joint_account_count
FROM account a
JOIN account_holder ah1 ON a.account_id = ah1.account_id
JOIN account_holder ah2 ON a.account_id = ah2.account_id
JOIN organization_unit ou ON a.org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
WHERE ah1.party_id != ah2.party_id
  AND ah1.effective_to IS NULL
  AND ah2.effective_to IS NULL
  AND a.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name
ORDER BY
    joint_account_count DESC;

SELECT
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT lbs.loan_id) AS overdue_count,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.overdue_principal), 2) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN organization_unit ou ON ca.managing_org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND lbs.overdue_principal > 0
GROUP BY
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name
ORDER BY
    total_overdue_principal DESC;

SELECT
    rs.loan_id,
    COUNT(rs.installment_id) AS overdue_installment_count,
    ROUND(SUM(rs.principal_due), 2) AS overdue_principal_sum
FROM repayment_schedule rs
WHERE rs.status = 'OVERDUE'
GROUP BY rs.loan_id
HAVING ROUND(SUM(rs.principal_due), 2) > 120000000.0
ORDER BY overdue_principal_sum DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(rs.installment_id) AS overdue_installment_count,
    ROUND(SUM(rs.interest_due), 2) AS total_overdue_interest
FROM repayment_schedule rs
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON rs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE rs.status = 'OVERDUE'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(rs.installment_id) >= 30
ORDER BY overdue_installment_count DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) AS overdue_loan_count
FROM
    institution i
JOIN
    credit_agreement ca ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
JOIN
    loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN
    repayment_schedule rs ON ld.loan_id = rs.loan_id
WHERE
    rs.status = 'OVERDUE'
GROUP BY
    i.institution_id,
    i.institution_name
HAVING
    COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) >= 240
ORDER BY
    overdue_loan_count DESC;

SELECT
    rs.loan_id,
    rs.installment_no,
    rs.principal_due,
    rs.interest_due
FROM repayment_schedule rs
WHERE rs.status = 'OVERDUE'
  AND rs.principal_due > 90000000
ORDER BY rs.principal_due DESC;

WITH institution_limits AS (
    SELECT
        cf.institution_id,
        SUM(cf.limit_amount) AS total_limit_amount
    FROM credit_facility cf
    GROUP BY cf.institution_id
),
institution_disbursements AS (
    SELECT
        ca.institution_id,
        SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) AS total_disbursed_amount
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id
),
institution_capital AS (
    SELECT
        cs.institution_id,
        cs.net_capital
    FROM capital_snapshot cs
    WHERE cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
)
SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    il.total_limit_amount,
    id.total_disbursed_amount,
    ic.net_capital,
    ROUND(id.total_disbursed_amount * 1.0 / ic.net_capital, 4) AS disbursed_to_capital_ratio
FROM institution i
JOIN institution_limits il ON i.institution_id = il.institution_id
JOIN institution_disbursements id ON i.institution_id = id.institution_id
JOIN institution_capital ic ON i.institution_id = ic.institution_id
WHERE id.total_disbursed_amount > ic.net_capital
ORDER BY disbursed_to_capital_ratio DESC;

SELECT
    sa.security_id,
    sa.secured_amount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT gc.guarantor_party_id) AS guarantor_count,
    SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) AS total_guaranteed_amount
FROM
    security_agreement sa
JOIN
    guarantor_commitment gc ON sa.security_id = gc.security_id
WHERE
    sa.security_type = 'GUARANTEE'
    AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY
    sa.security_id,
    sa.secured_amount
HAVING
    SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) < sa.secured_amount
ORDER BY
    total_guaranteed_amount DESC;

SELECT
    cf.facility_id,
    cf.limit_amount,
    sc.name_zh
FROM
    credit_facility cf
JOIN
    status_catalog sc
    ON sc.entity = 'credit_agreement'
    AND sc.status_code = cf.status
WHERE
    cf.facility_type = 'REVOLVING'
ORDER BY
    cf.limit_amount DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    cf.facility_type,
    ROUND(SUM(cf.limit_amount), 2) AS total_limit_amount
FROM
    credit_facility cf
JOIN
    institution i ON cf.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY
    i.institution_name,
    cf.facility_type
HAVING
    SUM(cf.limit_amount) > 2000000000
ORDER BY
    total_limit_amount DESC;

SELECT
    cf.facility_type,
    COUNT(*) AS record_count
FROM
    credit_facility cf
WHERE
    cf.limit_amount > 300000000
GROUP BY
    cf.facility_type
ORDER BY
    record_count DESC;

SELECT
    pm.payment_mode_name_zh,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS record_count
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN payment_mode_catalog pm ON ld.payment_mode = pm.payment_mode
GROUP BY
    pm.payment_mode_name_zh
ORDER BY
    record_count DESC;

WITH product_ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id,
        NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY actual_raise_amount DESC) AS group_id
    FROM wealth_product
    WHERE status = 'ON_SALE'
),
group_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        group_id,
        COUNT(*) AS product_count
    FROM product_ranked
    WHERE minimum_holding_days > 0
    GROUP BY group_id
)
SELECT 
    group_id,
    product_count
FROM group_counts
WHERE product_count BETWEEN 31 AND 33
ORDER BY group_id ASC;

SELECT
    ROUND(SUM(cf.limit_amount), 2) AS 循环授信限额合计,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS 发放笔数
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN credit_facility cf ON ca.facility_id = cf.facility_id
WHERE cf.facility_type = 'REVOLVING'
  AND ld.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT'
GROUP BY ld.agreement_id
ORDER BY 循环授信限额合计 DESC;

SELECT
    pmc.payment_mode_name_zh,
    COUNT(pi.instruction_id) AS instruction_count
FROM
    payment_instruction pi
JOIN
    payment_mode_catalog pmc ON pi.payment_mode = pmc.payment_mode
WHERE
    pi.status = 'PENDING'
GROUP BY
    pmc.payment_mode_name_zh
ORDER BY
    instruction_count DESC;

SELECT
    it.name_zh AS 融资工具中文名称,
    sc.name_zh AS 实体状态中文名称
FROM
    instrument_type_catalog it
CROSS JOIN
    status_catalog sc
WHERE
    sc.entity = 'loan_drawdown'
ORDER BY
    it.name_zh,
    sc.name_zh;

SELECT
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sa.staff_id) AS credit_manager_count
FROM organization_unit ou
JOIN staff_assignment sa ON ou.org_unit_id = sa.org_unit_id
JOIN staff_member sm ON sa.staff_id = sm.staff_id
JOIN party p ON sm.person_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE sa.role_code = 'CREDIT_MANAGER'
GROUP BY
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name
ORDER BY
    credit_manager_count DESC;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id,
    cg.grade_name_zh,
    ds.principal_overdue_days,
    ds.overdue_principal
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN delinquency_snapshot ds ON ld.loan_id = ds.loan_id
JOIN risk_classification rc ON ld.loan_id = rc.loan_id
JOIN classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
WHERE ds.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND rc.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND ds.principal_overdue_days > 30
  AND cg.grade_code = 'NORMAL'
ORDER BY ds.principal_overdue_days DESC, ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(ps.loan_id) AS count
FROM
    provision_snapshot ps
JOIN
    loan_drawdown ld ON ps.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN
    institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE
    ps.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND ps.provision_stage = '2'
    AND ps.recognized_amount < 0.5 * ps.required_amount
GROUP BY
    i.institution_name
ORDER BY
    count DESC,
    i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(SUM(p.required_amount - p.recognized_amount), 2) AS provision_gap_total
FROM
    provision_snapshot p
JOIN
    loan_drawdown l ON p.loan_id = l.loan_id
JOIN
    credit_agreement ca ON l.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN
    institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE
    p.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND p.required_amount > p.recognized_amount
GROUP BY
    i.institution_id,
    i.institution_name
ORDER BY
    provision_gap_total DESC,
    i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT
    a.account_id,
    a.account_subtype,
    ABS(ABS(a_bs.ledger_balance)) AS ledger_balance
FROM account a
JOIN account_balance_snapshot a_bs
    ON a.account_id = a_bs.account_id
LEFT JOIN account_holder ah_primary
    ON a.account_id = ah_primary.account_id
    AND ah_primary.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
LEFT JOIN account_holder ah_secondary
    ON a.account_id = ah_secondary.account_id
    AND ah_secondary.holder_role = 'SECONDARY'
WHERE a.account_kind = 'SAVINGS'
  AND a.status = 'DORMANT'
  AND ah_primary.account_id IS NOT NULL
  AND ah_secondary.account_id IS NULL
  AND a_bs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
ORDER BY a_bs.ledger_balance DESC;

SELECT
    p.customer_segment,
    COUNT(p.party_id) AS customer_count
FROM
    party p
JOIN
    person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
WHERE
    p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
    AND pp.annual_income > 1000000
GROUP BY
    p.customer_segment
ORDER BY
    customer_count DESC,
    p.customer_segment ASC;

SELECT
    ma.asset_category_primary,
    COUNT(*) AS asset_count
FROM
    managed_asset ma
JOIN
    industry_sector isec ON ma.industry_code = isec.sector_code
WHERE
    isec.risk_category = 'RESTRICTED'
GROUP BY
    ma.asset_category_primary
HAVING
    COUNT(*) < 33
ORDER BY
    asset_count DESC,
    ma.asset_category_primary ASC;

SELECT
    p.party_id,
    pp.annual_income,
    SUM(cf.limit_amount) AS total_credit_limit,
    ROUND(SUM(cf.limit_amount) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income, 2) AS debt_service_ratio
FROM party p
JOIN credit_facility cf ON p.party_id = cf.obligor_party_id
JOIN person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
  AND pp.annual_income > 0
GROUP BY p.party_id, pp.annual_income
HAVING SUM(cf.limit_amount) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income > 3
ORDER BY debt_service_ratio DESC, p.party_id ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
    pp.occupation_code,
    pp.employment_sector,
    COUNT(p.party_id) AS customer_count
FROM party p
JOIN person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
GROUP BY
    pp.occupation_code,
    pp.employment_sector
ORDER BY
    customer_count DESC,
    pp.occupation_code ASC,
    pp.employment_sector ASC;

SELECT
    status AS card_status,
    COUNT(*) AS card_count
FROM payment_card
WHERE card_type = 'DEBIT'
GROUP BY status
ORDER BY card_count DESC, status ASC;

SELECT
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name,
    COUNT(pe.payment_id) AS transaction_count,
    ROUND(SUM(pe.amount), 2) AS total_amount
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN account acc ON pe.from_account_id = acc.account_id
JOIN payment_card pc ON acc.account_id = pc.settlement_account_id
JOIN organization_unit ou ON pc.holder_party_id = p.party_id AND p.home_org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
JOIN party p ON pc.holder_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE pc.card_type = 'CREDIT'
  AND pe.is_cash = 1
GROUP BY
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name
ORDER BY
    total_amount DESC,
    ou.unit_name ASC;

SELECT
    pe.payment_id,
    pc.card_id,
    pc.holder_party_id,
    pe.business_date,
    pe.amount
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN account a ON pe.from_account_id = a.account_id
JOIN payment_card pc ON a.account_id = pc.settlement_account_id
WHERE pc.card_type = 'CREDIT'
  AND pe.is_cash = 1
ORDER BY pe.amount DESC, pe.payment_id ASC, pc.card_id ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
    pc.holder_party_id AS 持卡人编号,
    COUNT(pe.payment_id) AS 现金交易笔数,
    ROUND(SUM(pe.amount), 2) AS 金额合计
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN payment_card pc ON pe.from_account_id = pc.settlement_account_id
JOIN card_type_catalog ctc ON pc.card_type = ctc.card_type
WHERE ctc.name_zh = '贷记卡'
  AND pe.is_cash = 1
GROUP BY pc.holder_party_id
HAVING COUNT(pe.payment_id) > 5
ORDER BY 现金交易笔数 DESC, 金额合计 DESC;

SELECT
    holder_party_id,
    COUNT(*) AS card_count
FROM payment_card
GROUP BY holder_party_id
HAVING card_count > 3
ORDER BY card_count DESC, holder_party_id ASC;

SELECT
    ct.name_zh AS 银行卡类型名称,
    COUNT(pe.payment_id) AS 交易笔数,
    ROUND(SUM(pe.amount) * 1.0 / COUNT(pe.payment_id), 2) AS 平均单笔金额
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN account a ON pe.from_account_id = a.account_id OR pe.to_account_id = a.account_id
JOIN payment_card pc ON a.account_id = pc.settlement_account_id
JOIN card_type_catalog ct ON pc.card_type = ct.card_type
WHERE pe.is_cash = 1
  AND pc.card_type IN ('CREDIT', 'DEBIT')
GROUP BY ct.name_zh
ORDER BY 平均单笔金额 DESC, 银行卡类型名称 ASC;

SELECT
    channel,
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
    ROUND(AVG(amount), 2) AS avg_amount
FROM payment_event
WHERE status = 'SETTLED'
  AND is_cash = 0
GROUP BY channel
HAVING avg_amount > 11780000
ORDER BY avg_amount DESC, channel ASC;

SELECT
    td.account_id,
    td.maturity_on,
    a.status
FROM
    term_deposit td
JOIN
    account a ON td.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE
    td.maturity_on IS NOT NULL
    AND td.maturity_on <= '2026-06-30'
    AND a.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY
    td.maturity_on DESC
LIMIT 200;

WITH CollateralValuationStats AS (
    SELECT
        cv.collateral_id,
        cv.valuation_amount,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cv.collateral_id ORDER BY cv.valuation_amount DESC) as rn,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY cv.collateral_id) as eval_count
    FROM collateral_valuation cv
)
SELECT
    ca.collateral_id,
    ca.asset_label,
    cvs.valuation_amount
FROM CollateralValuationStats cvs
JOIN collateral_asset ca ON cvs.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
WHERE cvs.eval_count >= 2
  AND cvs.rn = 1
ORDER BY cvs.valuation_amount DESC;

SELECT
    ca.collateral_id,
    ca.asset_label,
    COUNT(cl.collateral_link_id) AS link_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cl.security_id) AS distinct_security_count
FROM collateral_asset ca
JOIN collateral_link cl ON ca.collateral_id = cl.collateral_id
WHERE ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY ca.collateral_id, ca.asset_label
HAVING link_count >= 2
ORDER BY link_count DESC, ca.collateral_id ASC;

WITH loan_totals AS (
    SELECT
        cd.agreement_id,
        SUM(cd.disbursed_amount) AS total_disbursed_amount
    FROM loan_drawdown cd
    WHERE cd.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY cd.agreement_id
),
guarantor_links AS (
    SELECT
        gc.guarantor_party_id,
        gc.security_id,
        gc.guaranteed_amount,
        gc.effective_from,
        gc.effective_to,
        gc.status
    FROM guarantor_commitment gc
    WHERE gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
),
valid_guarantees AS (
    SELECT
